admitted_route.name: barttorvik.com live season file ({year}_team_results.csv) — the exact file hoopR::torvik_ratings() reads (verified in hoopR source: .torvik_text(paste0("/", year, "_team_results.csv"))); no API key
admitted_route.pinning: Per-pull SHA-256 snapshot. The route is a LIVING file that barttorvik.com regenerates in-season; the pin is the pull (timestamped bytes), not a commit. The morning pull for an America/Chicago date is that date's only admitted vintage.

coverage_probes.result: HTTP 200 — 365 team rows, all records 0-0 (preseason vintage; season starts 2026-11-01/02), regenerated 2026-10-28 (Last-Modified 00:14:35Z on first probe, 04:14:01Z on scripted pulls)
HTTP 200 — 365 team rows (prior-season file still served)
HTTP 200 with EMPTY body — refused by puller as SCHEMA_INVALID; hoopR documents coverage from 2008

drift_summary.comparison: Independent probe pull 2026-10-28T04:07Z vs scripted pull 2026-10-28T04:14Z (same URL, ~7 minutes apart)
drift_summary.finding: The living file is NOT byte-stable across the day. Two pulls 2 seconds apart were byte-identical (same SHA-256 and ETag); pulls ~7 minutes apart differed: barthag changed for all 365 teams (max |delta| 0.01074), adjoe max |delta| 0.37927, adjde max |delta| 0.02942, and 19 teams changed rank. Consequence: the provider promises no intra-day vintage; SportsEdge's pinned morning pull IS the vintage of record, and consumers must read the pinned snapshot, never re-fetch intraday.

known_limitations: Living file: values drift slightly between regenerations even in preseason (see drift_summary). Hash-pinning fixes OUR snapshot; it does not make the provider's file immutable. A re-pull with a different hash is a different vintage and is refused as a substitute (SOURCE_CHANGED_AFTER_SNAPSHOT).

Preseason vintage: at sample time the 2026-27 season has not started (first games 2026-11-01/02); every record is 0-0 and the ratings are Torvik's projections, not results-based ratings. The route will carry results-based ratings as the season progresses, under the same morning-pull discipline.

Team identity is name-based in this source (team, conf strings; no ESPN/NCAA IDs). Joins to the hoopR substrate require the admitted crosswalk, which does not yet exist; name-only joins are refused (same limitation as the historical admission, PR #2832).

barttorvik.com carries no machine-readable license grant for the CSV; T-Rank data remains Bart Torvik's. This repo stores hashes, manifests and retrieval code only — no sample data files — per PR #2832's precedent.

The R route (hoopR/toRvik) was verified by source inspection, not executed: no R runtime exists in the SportsEdge environment. hoopR::torvik_ratings reads this same file, so the R route offers no additional data path. toRvik::bart_archive reads the dead toRvik-data mirror (historical only, PR #2832).

routes_examined.name: Route 1 — api.cbbstat.com (ratings + ratings/archive)
routes_examined.verdict: FAILED from this runtime, again: TLS handshake completes (valid cert, TLS 1.3) but the server closes the connection without any HTTP response — curl (52) Empty reply from server on HTTP/2 and HTTP/1.1, Python urllib RemoteDisconnected, and the alternate fetcher could not resolve/fetch the URL at all. NOT ADMITTED.

routes_examined.name: Route 2 — cbbdata API (cbbdata.aweatherman.com docs; API host is api.cbbstat.com)
routes_examined.verdict: Free account unlocks an API key: cbd_create_account(username, email, password) registers and the key is emailed. The API would add dated ratings/archive endpoints. BUT its host is the same api.cbbstat.com that closes connections from this runtime, so the key alone does not establish a working route from here. Owner-decision item; NOT a dependency of the admitted route.

routes_examined.name: Route 3 — barttorvik.com/{year}_team_results.csv (the site's own season file)
routes_examined.verdict: WORKS. HTTP 200 for year=2027 with current-season (2026-27) ratings, 365 teams, file regenerated on 2026-10-28. This is the admitted route.

routes_examined.name: Route 4 — hoopR::torvik_ratings / toRvik from R
routes_examined.verdict: No R runtime in this environment (not installed); not executed. Source-verified instead: hoopR::torvik_ratings fetches /{year}_team_results.csv from barttorvik.com — identical to Route 3, no extra data path. toRvik::bart_archive reads the toRvik-data GitHub mirror (dead since 2023-06-20; historical admission PR #2832).

routes_examined.name: Route 5 — GitHub mirrors of current Torvik data
routes_examined.verdict: No living ratings mirror exists. GitHub search (barttorvik / torvik / trank, sorted by updated) returns apps and projects, not a maintained data mirror; the one repo with dated Torvik snapshots (tdub29/Bart) holds irregular Bart-vs-Kalshi extracts (Feb 2025 / Feb 2026), not a pinnable ratings feed. The toRvik-data mirror was last pushed 2023-06-20. Direct-from-source (Route 3) is strictly better: no middleman.
